scope: Offline observer and focused-resource integration validation; not a local complete-suite rerun or hosted acceptance.
production_changes: None. Product Python sources remain identical to the prior complete-suite source map, as recorded in coordinator-priority.json.

verified_challenges: Command-line arguments, including spaces, arrive unchanged at the module entry point.
Passing and failing actual pytest sessions retain numeric exit codes 0 and 1.
An actual collection error retains exit code 2 and the collection-failure trace row.
A real unconfigure RuntimeError survives failed observer writes and close.
A passing pytest exit followed by an injected native atexit exit 7 remains process exit 7.
An unexpected exception and closed stdout retain nonzero process exits.
String SystemExit values are excluded from the independent diagnostic journal.
An existing journal is not overwritten; journal open/write failures preserve the target verdict.
The existing assertion, Qt-fatal and mocked-clock/serializer trace probes retain their expected behavior.
observer_gate.review: Independent read-only review found no exit-preservation, custody, deadline or curated-log privacy blocker.

ci_launcher_resource_gate.command: venv/Scripts/python.exe -X faulthandler -m tools.ci_pytest -q -p tools.pytest_execution_trace tests/test_sandbox_resource_bounds.py tests/test_source_sandbox_hardening.py tests/test_sandbox_editor_lifecycle.py tests/test_cycle26_round3_runtime_auth.py tests/test_cycle26_surface_hardening.py --junitxml=.tmp/ci-resource-integration.xml

normalization: Source hashes replace CRLF with LF. JUnit and local journal hashes cover their raw bytes.

prior_local_failed_probe.summary: 13 passed, 1 failed in the initial 14-case selection. The existing Qt-fatal child's trace showed collection failure before test-start; the old assertion discarded subprocess stdout/stderr.
prior_local_failed_probe.cause: Unconfirmed. Subsequent exact child probes reached the intended fatal result; they do not reconstruct the earlier failure.
prior_local_failed_probe.followup: The assertion now includes child exit/stdout/stderr on failure, the observer records failed collection reports, and an intentional collection-error canary verifies that path. The reviewed 15-case gate is the acceptance result; the failed artifact was retained.

limits: The historical hosted Python 3.10 post-summary exit 1 remains unexplained; this observer records future evidence without changing verdicts.
The atexit markers bracket Python callbacks registered during pytest. Earlier callbacks, later Config cleanup and native finalization are outside those marker boundaries.
CI prints curated status fields and nodeids without parametrized values; it excludes raw failure text, Qt message text and arbitrary exception values from diagnostic tails.
Hosted full-matrix and security acceptance must be verified separately after publication.
